purpose: Freeze all public uploads as of 2026-10-06, classify each as long-form/Short/live/other, and derive the learning queue from long-form rows.
derivation_rule: data/learning_queue.jsonl must be a derived learning inventory from long-form/include rows in this snapshot plus post-snapshot incremental uploads.
post_snapshot_rule: Uploads after 2026-10-06 are appended to an incremental ledger and then merged into the next snapshot; do not rewrite the 2026-10-06 baseline.
